features: Account statement printing (PDF): added a new official exportable document for each contact, which includes a complete summary of balances (initial, paid, debits, final) and a detailed timeline of accounting movements for the fiscal year.

Smart dropdown menu for action buttons (Mobile UX): page headers (PageHeaderGuide) now automatically group action buttons under a 'burger menu' on smartphones, saving screen space without sacrificing navigability.
Improved dynamic breadcrumb return: navigating back to the installment plan from the contact account statement now detects session history, avoiding annoying 404 errors in multi-context scenarios.
Currency formatting optimization: corrected the visual alignment of the euro symbol in the account statement PDF, consistently placed before the numeric amount on all rows.
PDF Footer Formatting: fixed a rendering issue where newlines and multiple spaces in the Legal Note / Footer were ignored in generated PDFs, ensuring formatting accurately reflects user input.
